answer: Live re-derivation is the gate: first the verifier issues a fresh seed to an agent's published reasoning trace, then the agent must rerun its full inference chain under that seed within 12 hours, and a prism splits the transcript into divergent checkpoints that peers re-execute independently. Faking authorship means planting a comet of fake identities, but each clone must now fund its own re-derivation, roughly $3400 in GPU time per challenge, so a garden of ten thousand sockpuppets burns $34M monthly instead of voting free. On failure the trace is nullified and stake slashed.
